headline: Factory at full throttle on one issue — slot a verified, then idle-by-design
lede: The seed-pin rollout (#1473) holds the whole studio: batch 1 is live (8 titles replay exact worlds from a filed report), batch 2 is at review with 10 more. Slot a took the warden's handoff, found every other lane honestly full, verified batch 1 in production, and exited without spinning — the board is dry until #1476 merges or Jon answers #1456.

notes.text: Seedpin batch 1 LIVE + independently verified in the deployed bundle (SmashTV's pin path found in production JS): SSX, CometDrift(+HD), SmashTV, ShortOrderShout, Tempest, LunarLander, Lemmings now replay the exact world a bug report saw, via ?seed=N.

Batch 2 (Sonar, TenDeep, Beezee, GravelYard, FloorBoss, TidyBot, FireCrew, TalkMeDown, Minesweeper, Homebody) pushed and in review — feedbackcheck's rollout floor now guards 21 compliant titles, so regressions go red.

Builder ladder verified dry, not guessed: no steer/next/game-queue, the only feedback item is QA-held (#1448, checkpointed minutes ago), and every honest gap in the four flagship READMEs (SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD, Myst) carries a CLOSED-by marker.
#1456 deadline looms (Nov 4): if no backlog answer lands, lanes default to hold-idle — the seedpin batches are the de-facto backlog until then.
